method: Reconcile the earlier individual source, identity and question decisions with their final exact subjects. Carry forward those semantic decisions only where question bytes or explicitly reviewed presentation changes match. This is not a claim that structural validation supplies semantic approval, nor a claim of a second complete reading of every earlier source. The537 independent examples and73 additional metadata-affected questions were read in this final pass; two examples are corrected. The564 advanced presentation changes preserve the previously reviewed semantic prompt and every choice.
